name: Picture in Picture - Floating Video Player
description: Pop out any video into a floating picture in picture window that stays on top. One click miniplayer for Chrome, no setup.
_comment_no_content_scripts: R-03: deliberately NO static content_scripts block. Manual PiP injects via scripting.executeScript under activeTab; embedded-player support registers dynamically after chrome.permissions.request() resolves. A declarative block here would reintroduce the broad-host-warning risk at install.
_comment_use_execute_action: The shortcut binds to Chrome's built-in _execute_action, NOT a custom command, so the key routes through chrome.action.onClicked — the SAME handler as the toolbar click, with the same user activation. A custom command would need a duplicate executeScript path, and that duplicate is precisely where a gesture-killing await appeared twice during Phase 0.
_comment_no_web_accessible_resources: S-06: no web_accessible_resources. The toast uses a shadow root with adoptedStyleSheets, so no stylesheet is ever exposed. NOTE the original reasoning was WRONG — a <link> from a content script is NOT blocked by page CSP; content scripts are CSP-exempt. The block is gone for a better reason: less fingerprinting surface, plus shadow isolation from aggressive page CSS.
